description: Erection of a single storey rear extension; removal of some existing windows and installation of new repositoned windows to the roof of the existing house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (FLU.526.4.01 Rev C, FLU.526.4.02 Rev B, FLU.526.4.03 Rev C, FLU.526.4.03 Rev C (Location Plan), FLU.526.4.04 Rev B, FLU.526.4.05 Rev B & FLU.526.4.06 Rev A, received on 15/10/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
